name: Space-time Neural Irradiance Fields
aliases: Space-time Neural Irradiance Fields for Free-Viewpoint Video
definition: A representation of a 4D space-time irradiance field as a function that maps a spatiotemporal location (x,t) to the emitted color and volume density, F : (x,t) → (c, σ ).
summary: Space-time Neural Irradiance Fields is a differentiable volume rendering method that synthesizes free-viewpoint videos from a single moving camera by using empty-space and static-scene losses to prevent artifacts.
